title: token-level observability: metrics + tracing + dashboards + alert tuning
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Adds token-level cost and latency breakdown metrics, updates dashboards and alert thresholds to reduce false positives; improves tracing spans for inference requests.
description: Motivation: provide token-level visibility into cost and latency across the serving runtime to help SREs and ML engineers correlate regressions (model, input distribution, infra) to unit economics. This PR introduces new Prometheus metrics, recording rules, and Grafana dashboards for token-level cost/latency breakdowns, improves span tagging in the inference trace pipeline, and adjusts alert thresholds and alerting logic to reduce noise. What changed: 1) Telemetry: Added metrics redwood_inference_tokens_total{model,route,shard,tier} and redwood_inference_token_latency_seconds_bucket with labels for model_version, route, and cost_tier. Added redwood_inference_token_cost_cents_total and per-token histograms. 2) Recording rules: Prometheus recording rules to materialize per-minute aggregates and 95/99 latency summaries to reduce query cost. 3) Dashboards: New Grafana dashboard JSON (dashboards/token-level-cost-latency.json) with panels for per-route token cost, token P95/P99 latency, KV cache hit correlation, and per-model cost/latency heatmaps. 4) Tracing: Instrumented runtime dispatcher to add span attributes: token_index, token_generation_ms, model_variant, and batch_id. 5) Alerts: Tuned alert thresholds and added suppression windows to avoid regression storms during rollout windows; alerts now use recording rules to evaluate. 6) SDK: Small metrics export helpers in redwood-sdk-python to tag token-level metrics when streaming. 7) Tests & docs: Unit tests for metric registration and dashboard docs under docs/observability/token-level.md. Checklist: - [x] Telemetry schema reviewed with SRE - [x] Grafana JSON validated locally - [x] Prometheus rules tested in staging - [x] Backwards-compatible metric names - [x] Docs updated - [x] Add tests Summary of impact: ~+820 additions, +230 deletions, no customer-facing API changes. Deployment plan: roll out telemetry in canary -> monitor token-level dashboards for expected baselines -> progressively increase traffic. Rollback: disable new metrics via feature flag and revert recordings if noise increases.
